metric_config.scope: Fresh matched native N versus trajectory-tangent helper T; both start at the same trajectory-aligned requested yaw. Raw geometric targets remain the primary objective; no tuning or automatic adoption.

clock.moving_interval: Half-open [3,35); all physical-state windows otherwise include actual terminal state.
clock.command_interval: Exclude final emitted but unheld command; include actual prior input for command-step metrics.

heading_benefit.definition: Each Tphase must reduce wrapped rawgeometric-tangent headingerror RMS and exact Eulerheading-rate tracking RMS to rawanalytic tangent psi_dot by at least20percent over[3,45]s versus matchedN.
heading_benefit.actual_rate_definition: Let h=R(q)[:,0] and hdot=omega_world cross h. Exact Eulerheadingrate=(hx*hdot_y-hy*hdot_x)/(hx^2+hy^2); horizontal forwardprojection denominator must exceed1e-8. Physical world-z angularvelocity is a distinct diagnostic, not the primary rate.
heading_benefit.raw_target_policy: Planned Sgeometric tangent,including zero-speed holds. Desiredheading/rate never follow measured drift; endgeometric tangent retained atstop.
heading_benefit.command_target_policy: Rawanalytic C2target equals command target if frozen rate/accel guards pass. Any reference shaping/lag must be explicit, and raw objectives remain primary.

helper_activity.definition: Count actual held intervals with norm of recorded native heading_command[:3] at least threshold. Record original helper eligibility and lever/load masks separately.
helper_activity.limitation: This is helper activity before fade/clipping, not a full applied-command counterfactual. Actual clipping and fade are reported separately.

settling.scope: Descriptive original4conditions and original4 plus raw final geometric heading error<=10degrees. No allphase settling-only adoption claim.

hard_contracts: All six episodes complete45s, finite physicalstate/held commands, no declaredphysicalfailure, applied=clip(requested), caps and actualpriorhistory valid.

RawXY/V/A clocks and rawtangent heading/rate/acceleration are common and match independent frozen Sgeometry/progress at actualtimestamps. Fullpath and finalgoal stayfixed afterearlystop.

reference_guards.raw_command_identity: Bothpolicies log commonplanned raw/command streams; no postresult targetfiltering or shaping. Rawanalyticrate/accel must satisfyguard before physics.

controller_scope: Minimal tangent-heading overlay. Native LQR angular-velocity reference remains zero; its rate feedback can compete with commanded turns. Results do not establish impossibility of fully reference-consistent tangent tracking.
lqr_rate_reference_policy: Original LQR angular-velocity reference remains zero; original rolling allocation handles translation only. This is a heading-helper overlay, not a coordinated planar-pose reference/allocator. Existing rate feedback may oppose intended turns and its contribution is logged via K/error.
interpretation: Trajectory-tangent heading with exact Euler-rate feedback versus native observer baseline. Raw geometric objectives are primary; command-target lag separately reported. Physical world-z angular velocity is diagnostic, not Euler heading rate. No old-baseline replay because both initial yaws changed. No automatic adoption; settling descriptive.
